997-3861-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4885-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2919-4268-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4268-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7509.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
5256-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1824-2530-3168-7351.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2530-3168-7351.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3168-7351.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

3698-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: At least two opponents have lost life this turn.
3698-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
3698-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
When the Mutagens enter, Grinding Station triggers that many times, untapping Grinding Station
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 3.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-3761-4668-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-3761-4668-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

2018-2713-4050-7216.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter, adding {W}.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Moonlit Lamenter from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a flying counter on it.
Activate Moonlit Lamenter by paying {W} and removing the flying counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2366-4785-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4785-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-2034-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1669-3234-3293-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-6798.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-6798.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

457-2604-5078-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

413-1684-2178-4871.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
413-1684-2178-4871.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Rakka Mar trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

109-1235-4863-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, targeting Twinflame.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Fork, creating a copy of Twinflame, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fork to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
After the first iteration, you may instead target Revolutionist and any other creature you control using the Twinflame copies.

1760-3556-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.
1760-3556-4364.description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Flicker from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Flicker, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

225-539-2375-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic Mountain, Forest or Swamp in library.
225-539-2375-5077.description:
Play Riveteers Overlook.
Riveteers Overlook enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Resolve the Riveteers Overlook trigger, causing you to sacrifice it, then search your library for a basic Forest, Swamp or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Riveteers Overlook from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

251-2034-2831.notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Glen Elendra Archmage does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
251-2034-2831.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage, adding {C}{C}.
Glen Elendra Archmage dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Glen Elendra Archmage enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting a +1/+1 counter on Glen Elendra Archmage.
Repeat.

2034-3773-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades, adding {C}{C}.
Cultivator of Blades dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Cultivator of Blades from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Cultivator of Blades enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-4338-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1479-3861-4488.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3861-4488.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2104-2556-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Mnemonic Wall.
2104-2556-4305.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
